verdict.rationale: Sentry documents first-party SDKs maintained by the Sentry team for most popular languages and frameworks. They cover mobile (an Android SDK that automatically reports errors and exceptions; Dart), backend (an Elixir SDK with automatic error reporting; .NET with cross-service tracing), and web via JavaScript, with a drop-in, five-line setup. Missing for 10: explicit evidence that the browser/frontend SDK automatically captures uncaught errors (only implied via the JavaScript source maps docs), and independent hands-on corroboration of automatic capture across platforms.
